newsitem.title: FRANCE: France's Chirac offers condolences over Mecca fire.
newsitem.headline: France's Chirac offers condolences over Mecca fire.

text.p: French President Jacques Chirac expressed condolences on Wednesday to families of more than 200 Moslem pilgrims who died when fire swept through their encampment near the holy city of Mecca.

"It is with great sadness that I just learned of the tragedy with has struck the Kingdom and the whole of the Moslem community in this sacred time of pilgrimage," Chirac wrote in a letter to Saudi Arabian King Fahd.
Chirac sent "very sad condolences" and "deep sympathy" to Fahd and families of the victims on behalf of the French people and himself.
The blaze, starting from a cooking gas cylinder and fanned by high winds as it raced through a vast sea of tents, killed at least 217 and injured nearly 1,300.
Most of the victims were reported to be from India, Pakistan and Bangladesh. They were among some two million Moslems from 100 countries gathering for the annual haj pilgrimage.
